reason: Withdraw the incoming Dover publication because the saved evidence does not support its hiring-funnel credit and a listed API specification is missing from the judged inputs. Dover has no accepted baseline verdict to restore for an individual cell.

findings.reason: The cited passage describes saving a chart as PNG, opening it full screen and sharing it. It does not establish stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness or offer acceptance metrics. The incoming partial credit is unsupported by the saved pack.

The proposed product record already lists the API specification, but the judged pack omits it and reports no downloadable specification. The source recheck returned HTTP 200 with Swagger 2.0 and title Dover API. This incomplete assessment is not published as a capability absence.
